scripts.synth:marketplace: mkdir -p dist && cdk synth -c marketplace=1 --json tokener-marketplace 2>dist/synth.log > dist/tokener-marketplace.template.json && node scripts/check-template.mjs dist/tokener-marketplace.template.json
scripts.lint:marketplace: if [ -x .venv/bin/cfn-lint ]; then .venv/bin/cfn-lint --non-zero-exit-code error dist/tokener-marketplace.template.json; else echo 'cfn-lint not installed: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install cfn-lint'; fi
scripts.release:template: npm run synth:marketplace && npm run lint:marketplace
